hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: My Skills delegated-wait exception: While supervising an active implementer with an agreed completion or checkpoint window, use event-driven mailbox waits. In this state, this instruction replaces the default requirements to provide commentary every 60 seconds and avoid waits longer than 60 seconds. Bound the assignment up front with milestones, immediate blocker reporting, and a credible stall deadline. Choose a generous timeout for the work, usually about 30 minutes for a substantial package, within the tool's maximum; messages or completion can end the wait early. Give an update before waiting, then resume on an inbox event, user input, or the agreed stall deadline. An empty timeout within that envelope calls directly for another wait, without commentary, inspection, or status polling merely because time passed. Handle a missed promised event through the workflow's stall procedure. Outside delegated waiting, retain the normal communication guidance. This exception does not authorize delegation or change ownership, acceptance, writer settlement, or approval requirements.
